notes: Sprites and palettes were extracted directly from the supplied ROM.
Palette index 0 is exported as transparent.
front/ contains the primary front battle frame and is the easiest folder to use for a Pokédex.
front_frame2/ exists only for species whose ROM graphic contains a second front animation frame.
Shiny sprites reuse the same pixel graphics with the ROM's shiny palette.
Species/form IDs are included in filenames so they match the extracted JSON datasets.
